description.value: Pho Kitchen is a Vietnamese family restaurant on Hebb Avenue in Vancouver serving pho, banh mi, rice and vermicelli dishes, and starters such as summer rolls and spring rolls. The restaurant emphasizes a clean, spacious dining room with quick and friendly service and a flexible menu that accommodates substitutions. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with pickup and Uber Eats delivery options.
